high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account `_spacetalkies_`. The post features a dramatic landscape with a large, glowing sun in the sky, casting a warm light over a rugged, mountainous terrain. The sky has hues of orange and purple, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. The text overlay on the image reads: "Sun as Magnifier!" followed by a detailed caption that explains the challenge of capturing the clearest photo of the nearest known Earth-like exoplanet to us, Proxima b. It mentions that even the largest telescopes on Earth cannot achieve this clarity.
